summary: John Hancock Comvest Private Income Fund, a BDC, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting routine monthly dividends across share classes, net asset values as of June 30, 2026, and ongoing continuous offering status. The filing discloses Class I dividend of $0.1864 per share, NAV of $25.09 per share, aggregate NAV of $477.5 million, and approximately $517.4 million raised in the offering. No special-situation events such as acquisitions, tenders, or restructuring are present; this is a routine periodic disclosure.
